comment: The carried light: the light on the lead that follows its drawn place on each frame (D-847). The light draws while the party holds the torch out, and never while the torch is put away (D-848, D-1064). The x and the y put the light at the top of the torch in the hand of the lead, from the west edge and the feet of the lead (D-1069). The fire is the flame and the embers of the torch in the hand, and the light steps between its levels as a wall torch does (D-890, D-891). The glow keeps a strength of 0, because the flame draws over the lead, and a glow there reads as a sprite that glows (D-188, D-912).
